subject: Painting and Decorating
examFormat: Three papers, all to be taken; Papers 1 and 2 form a composite paper taken in 3 hours. Paper 1: forty multiple choice questions in 1 hour for 40 marks, drawn from all topics. Paper 2: six essay-type questions, four to be answered in 2 hours for 60 marks. Paper 3 (Decorative Painting, practical): two alternative tasks of which one is attempted, 3 hours, 100 marks; the requirements are released at least two weeks before the examination and the work is executed under WAEC supervision. Works may be in poster colours or acrylic colours.

topics.name: Introduction to Painting
objectives: Explain the meaning of pictorial and decorative painting
State the differences between pictorial and decorative paintings
Identify tools and equipment in decorative and pictorial paintings
Describe the elements and principles of design
State the functions of pictorial and decorative painting

topics.name: Colour Theory
objectives: Explain the meaning of colour
Classify colours into primary, secondary and tertiary
Describe the properties of colour (hues, tones and intensity)
Describe colour schemes (analogous, complementary and monochromes)
Improvise colours from local sources

subtopics.name: Techniques in Pictorial Painting
objectives: Describe dry painting
Describe wet painting
Describe glazing
Describe impasto
Describe fresco
Describe tempera

subtopics.name: Techniques in Decorative Painting
objectives: Describe flat painting
Describe rag rolling
Describe scumbling or combing
Describe spraying
Describe mural
Describe mosaic

topics.name: Types and Functions of Pictorial Painting
objectives: Describe still life painting, nature painting and figure/life painting
State the differences between observatory and imaginative painting compositions
State the functions of pictorial paintings

topics.name: Types and Functions of Decorative Painting

subtopics.name: Body Decoration
objectives: Explain the meaning of body decoration
State the differences between traditional and modern body decorations
Identify motifs and designs for body decoration
Identify materials used for body decoration
State the functions and importance of body decorations

subtopics.name: Wall Decoration
objectives: Explain the meaning of wall/interior decoration
State the differences between traditional and modern wall decorations
Identify motifs, patterns and designs for wall decoration
Identify materials used for wall decoration
State the functions and importance of wall decorations

topics.name: Perspective
objectives: Explain the meaning of perspective
Identify the types of perspective
State the importance of perspective in pictorial painting composition

topics.name: Prospects in Painting
objectives: State the socio-economic value of pictorial and decorative painting
Identify careers in pictorial and decorative painting

subtopics.name: Costing of Paintings
objectives: Cost pictorial and decorative painting based on location and size of work, materials/equipment involved, time invested, and quantity and quality

subtopics.name: Exhibition of Paintings
objectives: Describe the planning and processes of exhibiting paintings
Describe the funding of exhibitions

subtopics.name: Marketing of Painting
objectives: Describe pricing, negotiation, communication (advertising/publicity), outlets for marketing and selling
